facts.text: Under the Jarvis Promise, Jarvis Christian University awards all enrolled students an Academic Pathway Scholarship rebate of $500 per semester, totaling approximately $4,000 over four years.

sources.title: Affordability - Jarvis Christian University
sources.quote: Through the Jarvis Promise, all students are eligible for a merit-based Academic Pathway Scholarship or a rebate ($500 per semester), amounting to approximately $4,000 over a four-year period.

sources.title: About - Jarvis Christian University
sources.quote: Founded in 1912, Jarvis Christian University is a private, historically Black liberal arts university affiliated with the Christian Church (Disciples of Christ).
